transcript.text: Bosch WTN85201GB condenser dryer not drying properly anymore, clothes still damp after 2 hrs. any ideas

Yes. On a condenser dryer like yours, clothes still damp after two hours is most often caused by restricted airflow from built-up fluff, which is usually simple to fix yourself. From what you have described, the most likely cause is clean the lint filter and the condenser/heat exchanger. Damp laundry is most often an airflow problem, and the first free check is the fluff filter in the door opening — heat-pump models often have a second filter at the bottom too. Was it full of fluff (and is it clean now), is the mesh torn, or was it already clean?
The door filters had fluff and a waxy film. Rinsed them under the tap and water barely passed through until I scrubbed them. They're clean now. Should I check anything else?
Good news, that has sorted it. If it happens again, start with the same check. Is there anything else I can help with?
